title: TensorPlate CLI Device Registry
description: Local registry of SSH-reachable devices the `tensorplate` CLI can remember and target. The CLI resolves this file from `$TENSORPLATE_DEVICE_REGISTRY`, else `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/tensorplate/devices.json`, else `~/.config/tensorplate/devices.json`. It stores only device access metadata and cached facts; it never stores SSH keys, passwords, or agent secrets. Writes are atomic (temp file + rename).

schema_version.description: Independent versioning track for the device registry. Unknown versions return a typed `config_invalid` error.

default_device.description: Device selected when no device is named explicitly. Must be a key of `devices`.

ssh_target.description: SSH destination: `user@host` or a bare `~/.ssh/config` host alias. No whitespace.

ssh_port.description: Optional SSH port. Defaults to the SSH client's own default when absent.

remote_tensorplate.description: Optional absolute path to the remote `tensorplate` binary. Must be absolute; a run-as invocation additionally requires it to be root-owned and not group/other-writable.

remote_run_as.description: Optional non-interactive run-as user for reaching the device-local agent. A plain username (letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.`).

remote_import_dir.description: Absolute remote staging directory for copied bundles. Recorded on every entry by `device add` (default `/var/lib/tensorplate/bundles/import`, override with `--import-dir`); may be absent in hand-edited registries.

last_seen.description: Cached timestamp of the last successful remote check. Populated by a later sync path.

agent_version.description: Cached remote agent version. Populated by a later sync path.

protocol_version.description: Cached remote protocol version. Populated by a later sync path.

device_family.description: Cached remote device family. Populated by a later sync path.

available_backends.description: Cached remote backend list. Populated by a later sync path.
